    • getAlias

      public String getAlias()
      Description copied from interface: PbcsMember
      The alias for this member. Although EPM cloud supports alias tables, the aliases don't seem to surface in the REST endpoint for fetching member information. The alias you get here is the "default" alias that comes back as a single property from the member info endpoint.
      Specified by:

    • getParentName

      public String getParentName()
      Description copied from interface: PbcsMember
      The name of this member's parent. If the member is already at the top of the dimension (i.e., it is the dimension member such as Version, Entity, etc.) the returned value will be null.
      Specified by:
      getParentName in interface PbcsMember
      Overrides:
      getParentName in class AbstractDelegatingMember
      Returns:
      the name of this member's parent, null if there is no parent

    • getLevel

      public int getLevel()
      Description copied from interface: PbcsMember
      Gets the calculated level of the member. The level appears to come back in the member info payload; however, it always has a value of 0. I believe this is an oversight on Oracle's part. Note: shared members will return the level of the shared member, not the prototype member. In other words, shared members will always have a level of 0 (since shared members cannot have children).
      Specified by:
      getLevel in interface PbcsMember
      Overrides:
      getLevel in class AbstractDelegatingMember
      Returns:
      the calculated level of this member

    • getGeneration

      public int getGeneration()
      Description copied from interface: PbcsMember
      Generation of the member. Tops of dimensions are, by definition, generation 1. The "outline itself" is considered to be generation 0 (philosophically).
      Specified by:
      getGeneration in interface PbcsMember
      Overrides:
      getGeneration in class AbstractDelegatingMember
      Returns:
      the generation of the member (1 for dimension, 2 for child of dimension, and so on)
